scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @comboroute/api" "npm run dev -w @comboroute/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @comboroute/core && npm run build -w @comboroute/web && npm run build -w @comboroute/api
scripts.test: npm run test:security && npm run build -w @comboroute/core && npm run test -w @comboroute/core && npm run test -w @comboroute/api && npm run test -w @comboroute/web
